events.name: Bash
events.head: GET channel accounts and draft campaign
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; K=$(tr -d '\n' < ~/.config/tantra/keys/tantra-workshop.key); B=https://api.usetantra.com/api/v1; curl -s -H "x-api-key: $K" $B/channels/accounts | python3 -c "import sys,json;d=json.load(sys.stdin);d=d.get('data',d) if isinstance(d,dict) else d;print([(a.get('provider') or a.get('type'),a.get('status')) for a in (d if isinstance(d,list) else d.get('items',[]))])"; curl -s -H "x-api-key: $K" $B/campaigns/6acc47385f16ab824d7d8132 | python3 -c "import sys,json;d=json.load(sys.stdin);d=d.get('data',d);print(d.get('status'),len(d.get('steps') or []))"
